====Usage notes====
The locative plural form {{m|pl|ręku}} (historically a locative dual form) may be used for a single hand/arm or the hands/arms of a single person, and is used chiefly directly after {{m|pl|w}} and {{m|pl|na}}, and it is proscribed to use any sort of adjective etc. between the preposition and the noun. This form may be considered slightly more higher register.

====Declension====
{{pl-decl-noun-f|nomp=ręce|genp=rąk|insp=rękami/rękoma|locp=rękach/ręku}}
* The {{w|Eastern Kraków dialect}} ({{w|Gdów}}, {{w|Bochnia}}) shows a nominative plural form {{m|pl|rece}}.
* The {{w|Chełmno-Dobrzyń dialect}} and {{w|Przemyśl dialect}} ({{w|San river}}) show a genitive plural form {{m|pl|ręców}}.
* The {{w|Chełmno-Dobrzyń dialect}} shows a dative plural form {{m|pl|ręcom}}.
* The {{w|Podlachia dialect}} ({{w|Narew}}), {{w|Przemyśl dialect}} ({{w|San river}}), and the {{w|Podhale dialect}} show an instrumental plural form {{m|pl|ręcami}}.
* The {{w|Central Greater Poland dialect}} ({{w|Oborniki}}, {{w|Szamotuły}}) shows a locative singular form {{m|pl|rękce}}.
* The {{w|Kujawy dialect}} shows a nominative plural form {{m|pl|ręki}}.
* The {{w|Far Masovian}} ({{w|Przasnysz}})) shows an accusative singular form {{m|pl|ręku}}.
